scripts.gen:types: mkdir -p web/lib/api && pnpm exec openapi-typescript backend/openapi.json -o web/lib/api/types.ts
scripts.docs:validate: cd docs && pnpm exec mint validate
scripts.docs:a11y: cd docs && pnpm exec mint a11y
scripts.test:docs-loop: pnpm run docs:validate && pnpm run docs:a11y && node --test tests/docs-contract.test.mjs && SETUP_MATRIX_BACKEND_URL=https://agent-feedback-api-v2-canary.up.railway.app SETUP_MATRIX_DB_ENVIRONMENT=v2-canary SETUP_MATRIX_SKIP_BUILD=true node tests/setup-matrix-e2e.mjs
